model: Distressed NAV recovery waterfall (scenario-weighted, cost of equity)
model_note: Routed to the dcf-methods 'Distressed, receivership' row: asset/creditor waterfall, not a going-concern FCF model. Owners' equity negative since FY2024, auditor disclaimers FY2024/FY2025/H1 FY2026, RMB82.4bn of borrowings defaulted or cross-defaulted, core operations loss-making beneath restructuring gains. A perpetuity owner-FCF DCF would project cash flows the business does not have.

inputs.fx_note: 1 CNY = 1.1724 HKD, Yahoo CNYHKD=X at 2026-10-16T22:02Z. Cross-check USDHKD 7.8479 / USDCNY 6.6768 = 1.1754 (0.3% apart). No dual listing to parity-check against.
inputs.share_count_basis: Fully diluted, H1 FY2026 interim report: 46,330.0m issued + MCB(A) max 11,158.3m + MCB(B) max 331.3m + SCA warrants max 756.0m + remaining Capitalisation (shareholder-loan equitisation) shares 9,417.4m = 67,992.9m. The MCBs are MANDATORY convertibles (conversion prices HKD2.6/HKD10 are irrelevant to whether they dilute) and are held as equity claims. Further dilution from the onshore bonds' stock option (yet to run, size undisclosed) is NOT included -- an unquantified downward risk to per-share value.
inputs.net_debt_note: Borrowings RMB142,661m less unrestricted cash RMB5,737m. Net debt (and every other liability) is already inside owners' NAV and is NOT deducted again.
inputs.sbc_source: FY2025 annual report cash flow statement (Metrics.csv StockBasedComp 109); equity-award taxes nil
inputs.last_fcf_note: Owner FCF FY2025 = 1,534 - 109 - 187 = 1,238, RMB m. Shown for audit only: it is working-capital run-off from a shrinking inventory book, not a recurring flow, and is not a valuation input.
inputs.nci_treatment: Valuation is on owners' equity only; NCI (RMB43.1bn) excluded. Total equity is positive only because of NCI in project companies.
inputs.lease_treatment: Lease liabilities (RMB2.4bn) sit inside owners' NAV; no separate treatment.
inputs.wacc_rationale: RMB cost of equity 13%: China 10y CGB ~1.8% + 1.6 beta x 6.5% ERP + ~0.8% small/illiquidity. Distress (re-default, wind-up) is charged ONCE, through the 40% bear weight at zero value, not again in the discount rate.
inputs.notes: Model: distressed NAV recovery waterfall (dcf-methods routing row 'Distressed, receivership, delisted, cash shell'), not owner-FCF. No prior valuation and no MEMORY.md entry. Bear = liquidation waterfall (nil to equity); base/bull = exit diluted owners' NAV at Dec-2029 after run-off losses and further debt-compromise gains, capitalised at an exit P/B and discounted at the RMB cost of equity. Per-share values in HKD (quote currency) via fx_rate; _cny twins carried.

historical_growth.growth_divergence_warning: Owners' equity negative FY2024-H1 FY2026, EPS negative FY2022-FY2024 and H1 FY2026, owner FCF negative/erratic: equity, EPS and FCF CAGRs are undefined. Revenue is in run-off (FY2021 peak RMB523bn -> FY2025 RMB155bn). No growth rate is used in this model.
historical_growth.notes: SBC (RMB109m FY2025) is immaterial against the balance sheet; the SBC-adjusted FCF series is not a valuation input for a run-off developer.

bear.narrative: Re-default / wind-up. RMB82.4bn of bank and other borrowings are already defaulted or cross-defaulted, RMB101.5bn of borrowings are current against RMB16.7bn total cash (RMB10.9bn restricted), the core business lost ~RMB15.6bn to owners in H1 FY2026, and the auditor cannot form a view on going concern for the third period running. If onshore lenders or suppliers enforce, the 'baojiaolou' (deliver-homes-first) policy puts homebuyers and secured project lenders ahead of everyone; inventory carried at RMB430bn would realise well below book in a forced sale and owners' book equity is already negative (-RMB9.4bn on a diluted basis). Ordinary equity recovers nil.
bear.note: Liquidation waterfall: secured project lenders and homebuyers (baojiaolou) rank first; owners' diluted book NAV is already negative before any forced-sale haircut, so equity is nil.

base.narrative: Zombie run-off survives. No liquidation: onshore lenders extend or compromise rather than enforce, the onshore stock / general-creditor options complete, and the company delivers its pre-sold backlog (contract liabilities RMB124.5bn) while contracted sales stay at ~RMB25-30bn/yr. Owner-level losses ex-gains shrink from the current ~RMB30bn+/yr pace as revenue and finance-cost accruals fall: RMB55bn cumulative to Dec-2029. Further debt-compromise gains on the defaulted onshore bank/trust debt, remaining bonds and supplier payables of RMB75bn (vs RMB82.1bn booked in FY2025 alone) lift diluted owners' NAV from -RMB9.4bn to about +RMB10.6bn. Equity of a sub-scale, still-impaired private developer is then priced at 0.3x book (distressed private-developer range), discounted 3.2 years at the 13% RMB cost of equity.

bull.narrative: Clean stabilisation. Onshore restructuring completes in 2027 on terms close to the offshore deal, inventory write-downs stop as tier-3/4 prices bottom, and losses ex-gains total only RMB35bn to Dec-2029 while compromise gains reach RMB90bn. Diluted owners' NAV recovers to about +RMB45.6bn, the disclaimer is lifted and the equity re-rates to 0.5x book.

bear.methodology: IV = max(0, exit diluted owners' NAV) x exit P/B / (1+CoE)^years / fully diluted shares x HKD-per-CNY

base.methodology: IV = max(0, exit diluted owners' NAV) x exit P/B / (1+CoE)^years / fully diluted shares x HKD-per-CNY

bull.methodology: IV = max(0, exit diluted owners' NAV) x exit P/B / (1+CoE)^years / fully diluted shares x HKD-per-CNY

entry_price.method: Same exit equity value discounted at the 15% hurdle instead of the 13% cost of equity; no interim distributions (none expected).

sensitivity.description: Base-case HKD/share vs exit diluted owners' NAV (rows, RMB m, Dec-2029) and exit P/B (columns), at 13% CoE over 3.21 years. A WACC x terminal-growth grid is meaningless for a run-off developer.

probability_weighted.weights_rationale: Bear 40%: third consecutive auditor disclaimer on going concern, RMB82.4bn of borrowings defaulted or cross-defaulted, RMB101.5bn current borrowings vs RMB16.7bn total cash, ongoing creditor/supplier litigation and an operating business still losing ~RMB15.6bn per half to owners. Not higher because the offshore scheme is done, the HK winding-up petition was dismissed (16 Feb 2026), the onshore bond plan was approved and is executing, and Beijing's baojiaolou priority favours orderly run-off over liquidation. Bull 15%: requires both onshore completion and a tier-3/4 price bottom, against Fitch's call for further 2026 sector contraction.
probability_weighted.band_note: SBC immaterial (0.07% of revenue): house and street bases coincide, band collapsed.

valuation_philosophy.summary: Country Garden's ordinary equity is a deep out-of-the-money claim on a run-off balance sheet, not a going concern with forecastable free cash flow. Owners' book equity is -RMB12.2bn (-RMB9.4bn counting the mandatory-convertible and equitisation liabilities that are really equity) under a disclaimed audit, so equity only has value if future creditor compromises outrun the operating losses still being booked. The model values that explicitly: nil in a wind-up, and an exit NAV x P/B in the survival cases, at the fully diluted ~68.0bn share count that the restructuring has already contracted. The ~HK$11.7bn diluted market capitalisation implies the market is paying for something close to the bull case.
valuation_philosophy.why_not_owner_fcf: Operations are loss-making beneath restructuring gains (FY2025 gross loss RMB43.1bn; H1 FY2026 owners' loss RMB15.6bn), revenue is in run-off (-39% YoY in H1 FY2026), OCF is working-capital liquidation of a shrinking inventory book, and the going-concern basis itself is disclaimed. Projecting a perpetuity of owner FCF would be fiction.
key_risks_to_valuation: Onshore bonds' stock option is still to run; its share issuance is not in the diluted count and would cut every per-share value.
Exit NAV is highly sensitive to the size of future compromise gains versus run-off losses; each RMB10bn of exit NAV moves base IV by ~HK$0.035 (at 0.3x P/B) and bull by ~HK$0.058 (at 0.5x).
Inventory (RMB430bn) is carried at cost less write-downs under a disclaimed audit; further write-downs (RMB6.2bn in H1 FY2026 alone) reduce NAV directly.
Policy: a stronger national housing stimulus would raise both exit NAV and exit P/B; selective 'white list' funding is the current pattern.
Upside risk: the controlling shareholder or a state-backed party recapitalises at a premium, which this model does not price.

data_sources.price: Yahoo Finance chart API at inputs.price_as_of; 52-week range 0.16-0.60 HKD
data_sources.financials: H1 FY2026 interim report (balance sheet, going-concern note 2.1, borrowings note 11, FVTPL note 12, share-capital disclosures under Corporate Governance), FY2025 annual report; Metrics.csv / core_metrics

sanity_check.basis: SBC-adjusted on both sides (EPS less SBC/share; EBITDA less SBC), so these deliberately do not match GAAP screener multiples.
sanity_check.checks_replaced: model is asset_waterfall: no multiples rule applies; the historical table is reported for context only
